title: Delta random intersection tail
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real parameter $\delta$, a subset $U\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and a natural number $k$, define the delta random intersection tail to be $\sum_{J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)} w_{n,\delta}(J)\,\mathbf{1}_{\{k\le |U\cap J|\}}$, where $w_{n,\delta}(J)$ denotes the delta random subset weight of $J$.
caveat: The definition of the delta random subset weight is not included in the supplied context, so its meaning can only be named, not explained.
